meanings: to come face to face with
forms: суочим се, суоче се; impf. суочавати се

examples.en: You have to face the truth.
We came up against a big problem.

note: суочити се са + instr.: to face something

examples.en: He has devoted his whole life to science.

examples.sr: Модерна [на̀ука] то не може да објасни.
examples.en: Modern science can't explain that.
Don't be a coward, give it a try!
A cuckoo can be heard in the forest.

note: feminine, but also used of a man: он је кукавица
tips: The related verb «кукати» means to whine or complain: «Престани да кукаш!» (Stop whining!).
Literally «cuckoo», figuratively «coward». Also: кукавичлук (cowardice). «Не буди кукавица!» - Don't be a coward!

examples.en: What's the point of all this?
You seem to have missed the point.
Knowing the language is a big plus.
Two plus two is four.

examples.sr: Деда је [у̀са̄мљен] откад је бака умрла.
examples.en: Grandpa has been lonely since Grandma died.
He lives in a lonely house on a hill.
The police arrested a dangerous criminal.
He's not a criminal, he just made a mistake.
This is a good remedy for mosquitoes.
We don't have the funds for the new project.
The apartment has an area of sixty square meters.
The fish swam up to the surface.
He ordered a glass of whiskey.
He drinks whiskey only with ice.

note: declines like a regular noun: вискија, вискију

examples.en: Put on a white shirt for the wedding.
This shirt needs ironing.
Pick a card.
Why did you choose him, of all people?

examples.sr: [Пру̀жио] ми је руку и насмешио се.
examples.en: He held out his hand to me and smiled.
Thank you for giving me a chance.

note: «пружити помоћ» - to give help

examples.en: The audience applauded for a long time.
I always get nervous in front of an audience.
We'll arrive in about an hour.
How much does it cost, roughly?
Wild animals live in the forest.
You're behaving like a beast!

note: feminine: дивља звер - a wild beast

examples.en: There are mice in the basement.
Click the button with the mouse.
Today we're doing lesson five.
That will be a good lesson for him.

note: A class period is «час»; a lecture is «предавање».

examples.en: You're safe here, don't be afraid.
This is a safe neighborhood for children.
The wolf attacked the sheep at night.
I'm as hungry as a wolf.

meanings: to move, to relocate (someone or something)

examples.sr: Прошле године смо се [прѐселили] у Београд.
examples.en: Last year we moved to Belgrade.
The factory was relocated to another city.

examples.sr: Код нас се ципеле [скѝдају] на улазу.
examples.en: In our country, shoes are taken off at the entrance.
Don't download movies from that site.
The meeting is still in progress.
Keep me posted, please.

note: у току - in progress; бити у току - to be up to date

examples.en: It was an awful day.
The food in that cafeteria is disgusting.
I'm aware of the risk.
I don't want us to take such a risk.
Something smells nice from the kitchen.
She was smelling the flowers in the garden.

tips: It works both ways: «цвет мирише» (the flower smells) and «пас мирише траву» (the dog sniffs the grass). Also «он га не мирише» - he can't stand him.
To smell of something takes «на + acc.»: мирише на пролеће, колач мирише на ванилу.

examples.en: It suddenly started to rain.
He came unexpectedly, without warning.

meanings: to give a ride, to drop off (colloq.)

examples.en: The court dismissed the lawsuit.

examples.sr: Можеш ли да ме [одба̀циш] до центра?
examples.en: Can you drop me off downtown?

tips: Means to reject («одбацила сам идеју» - I rejected the idea) and, colloquially, to give a lift: «одбаци ме до посла» (drop me off at work), «да те одбацим кући?» (shall I drop you home?).

examples.en: I don't want to be a slave to my job.
Slaves used to work in the fields.

note: not to be confused with «роба» (f.) - goods

examples.en: Put on a warm sweater, it's cold outside.
The water in the sea is still warm.

tips: Often also «hot»: топла вода (hot water), топли оброк (hot meal), топла чоколада (hot chocolate). Lukewarm water is «млака». «Јако је топло» - it's very hot (about weather).

examples.en: I bought a new T-shirt.
Put on a T-shirt with short sleeves.
New technology is changing our lives.
Grandpa doesn't understand technology.
I'm afraid of snakes.
Watch out, he's a real snake!
She has dark hair and blue eyes.
This room is too dark.

note: adverb «таман» - just in time: таман сам хтео да те зовем
tips: Besides «dark», «таман» is also an adverb meaning «just right, a perfect fit»: «Ове патике су ми таман» - these sneakers fit me perfectly.
The colloquial «таман посла» means «no way» or «don't mention it».

examples.en: I drink coffee without sugar.

examples.sr: Деда има [шѐћер] и пази шта једе.
examples.en: Grandpa has diabetes and watches what he eats.

meanings: to eat, to have a diet (reflexive)

examples.sr: Ко [хра̀ни] пса док сте на путу?
examples.en: Who feeds the dog while you're away?
You need to eat healthier.

tips: The reflexive «хранити се» means to eat, to have a diet.

examples.en: He gave me a clear answer.
Are the instructions clear?
I'm so damn tired.
This is damn hard.

note: colloquial, a bit rude

examples.en: We rented a boat on the lake.
The boat capsized because of the waves.
Wash your hands before eating.
I need to do the laundry.
The child has a fever.
Tonight the temperature will drop below zero.

meanings: to move aside, to put away
to get out of the way, to hide (reflexive)

examples.en: Get out of the way!
Don't look away when I'm talking to you.
The whole local community helped us.
They have been married for ten years.
Stop asking stupid questions.
Mom is setting the table for dinner.
My left leg hurts.
Drive in the left lane.

related.en: to the left, on the left

examples.sr: Пребаци на други [ка̀на̄л], ово је досадно.
examples.en: Switch to another channel, this is boring.
An old canal runs through the city.
He keeps refusing my help.
Why do you refuse to eat?
I wish you great success!
The film was a big success.

examples.sr: Он је [мо̏ћан] човек у овом граду.
examples.en: He's a powerful man in this town.
This is a very powerful computer.
He's an expert in this field.
It snows in the mountain regions.

note: feminine: у овој области

examples.en: My brother plays guitar in a band.
What's your favorite band?
I try to buy local products.
This item is currently unavailable.

forms: навикнем, навикну; навикао; var. навикнути; impf. навикавати

examples.sr: Брзо сам се [навѝкао] на нови посао.
examples.en: I quickly got used to the new job.
I got used to getting up early.

note: навићи се на + acc.: to get used to
tips: Навићи се на + acc.: навикла сам се на живот у Србији (I got used to life in Serbia).

examples.en: Whoa, I almost fell!
Wow, look who's here!
You don't have to explain anything to me.
The teacher is explaining the new lesson.
Never mention that name again!
She keeps mentioning her ex.
It's all God's will.
He's late every single blessed day.
Give me at least a little water.
I'll come, even if I'm late.

tips: A particle of emphasis: «Дај ми макар једну јабуку» - at least one apple; «Он је макар истину рекао» - at least he told the truth. In speech it is often replaced by «бар»/«барем».

examples.en: I admit that I made a mistake.
He never admits his mistakes.
In the summer we visited Tara National Park.
Tomorrow is a national holiday.
The knight killed the dragon.
The children are flying a kite in the meadow.
The driver sustained serious injuries.
That's a clear violation of the law.
We ran out of gas on the highway.
The price of fuel is rising again.
You look fantastic!
The vacation was incredibly nice.
I'm watching a new Turkish series.
This is the third series of tests.

note: A TV show is «серија»; a single episode is «епизода».

examples.en: You remind me of my brother.
I remind you that we start earlier tomorrow.

note: подсећати на + acc.: to remind of someone

examples.en: He didn't do it on purpose.
I was late on purpose.
Close the gate behind you.
I'm waiting for you in front of the gate.
Put the cap on the bottle so it doesn't leak.
The sink is clogged again.

note: rude: «зачепи!» - shut up!

examples.en: I like fruit, especially apples.
This applies especially to children.
He has the ability to learn languages quickly.
I believe in your abilities.
The mayor opened the new bridge.
I talked to the mayor.
The entire crew of the ship was rescued.

examples.sr: Капетан и [по̏сада] вам желе пријатан лет.
examples.en: The captain and crew wish you a pleasant flight.
We traveled in business class.
He's a world-class player.

note: A school class is «разред» or «одељење».

examples.en: The sun sets in the west.
Many young people are leaving for the West.

examples.sr: Немојте да се [гу̀рате], има места за све!
examples.en: Don't push, there's room for everyone!
He was pushing a stroller through the park.
He's the best student in the class.
The teacher has thirty pupils.
The movie was terribly boring.
Stop being so annoying!

tips: Of a thing it means «boring, dull»: «досадан филм» - a boring film. Of a person it means «annoying».

examples.en: She works at a travel agency.
We found the apartment through an agency.

examples.sr: Један [ста̏рац] седи на клупи у парку.
examples.en: An old man is sitting on a bench in the park.
He helped the old man cross the street.
That's a very interesting book.
How interesting, I didn't know that.

examples.sr: Мама је испекла [то̏рту] за мој рођендан.
examples.en: Mom baked a cake for my birthday.
Would you like a piece of cake?

tips: Feminine: «ова торта», «добра торта». A plainer, everyday kind of cake is «колач».

examples.en: All the workers wear a uniform.

examples.sr: На улазу је стајао полицајац у [унѝформи].
examples.en: A policeman in uniform was standing at the entrance.
What do you want to achieve in life?
We finally reached an agreement.
The public has the right to know the truth.
The news quickly became public.
Give me a kiss.
You never forget your first kiss.
He threw the plate in a rage.
He couldn't hold back his anger.
Make me a copy of the contract.
This isn't the original, it's a copy.
The lieutenant gave an order.
Understood, Lieutenant!
Dad is furious with me.
He was bitten by a rabid dog.

note: бесан на + acc.: angry at someone

examples.en: A pipe burst in the bathroom.
He pointed the barrel of the pistol at him.

note: feminine; a musical trumpet is «труба»

examples.en: He keeps his money in a safe.

examples.sr: Лопови су отворили [се̏ф] за пет минута.
examples.en: The thieves opened the safe in five minutes.
I have a business meeting at three.
He went on a business trip.
You look a lot like your father.
I have a similar problem too.

note: сличан + dat.: сличан оцу - like his father

examples.en: Grandpa has two cows in the village.
The cow is grazing peacefully in the meadow.
Gather your things and go.
We collected money for a present.

note: not to be confused with «скуп» (adj.) - expensive
tips: «Ајде да се скупимо» - let's chip in together (pool money), not only «let's get together».

examples.en: I like seafood.
The sea air does you good.
You need to rest a little.
We had a good rest by the sea.
The teacher punished him for being late.
The police fined me for speeding.
I've never seen such a crowd.
What do you need such a huge car for?
See you on Monday.
I have an English class on Mondays.

note: «понедељком» - on Mondays

examples.en: Do you want orange juice?
The children drink juice instead of water.

tips: In Serbia «сок» covers not only fresh juice but also boxed juices and sweet sodas (cola, Fanta, Sprite); the Cedevita drink is also called «сок».

examples.en: A bird is flying high above us.
Their house is high up in the mountains.
He graduated from college two years ago.
She studies at the Faculty of Philology.

note: «завршити факултет» - to graduate from university

examples.en: All the goods are in the warehouse.
He works nights at a warehouse.
My father works at a factory.
The factory was closed ten years ago.
We're looking forward to your arrival.
Let me know your arrival time.
What is the height of this building?
He's about my height.

tips: «Висина» means both a person's height (он има два метра висине) and altitude (надморска висина - height above sea level).
To ask how tall a person is, say «Колико си висок?». «С које висине?» - from what height?

examples.en: She takes great care of her appearance.
What are our chances of winning?
Open your book to page ten.
Check out our website.
The children are playing in the yard.
We have a big yard behind the house.
I've already spent my whole salary.

examples.sr: Не желим да [потро̀шим] цео дан на то.
examples.en: I don't want to spend the whole day on it.
Look at the map to see where we are.
The documents are in the blue folder.
Children love chocolate ice cream.
Let's have an ice cream each.
He has been in trade for twenty years.
Trade with Russia has grown.

note: In Serbia a shop is «продавница».

examples.en: I couldn't see anything in the dark.
My son is afraid of the dark.
We always go to the seaside in summer.
It's very hot here in summer.
Do you watch that show on TV?
He put on a real show at the wedding.

tips: It declines like a masculine noun: шоуа, шоуу, шоуом. In compounds it takes a hyphen: ријалити-шоу, ток-шоу, шоу-бизнис.

examples.en: The weather affects my mood.

examples.sr: Не дозволи да то [утѝче] на тебе.
examples.en: Don't let it affect you.

note: утицати на + acc.: to affect
tips: Утицати на + acc.: «утичем на одлуку» - I influence the decision. Not to be confused with «утисак» (impression) and «утицај» (influence, a noun).

examples.en: This is our old family house.
Every Sunday we have a family lunch.
Tonight we're celebrating his birthday.
Our family celebrates the feast of Saint Nicholas, our family patron saint.

note: «слава» - a family feast of the patron saint

examples.en: This is my friend from school.
She went out with her friends.
I read an interesting article in the newspaper.
She writes articles for a magazine.
I missed the train this morning.
Hurry up, we'll be late!

note: закаснити на + acc.: to be late for

examples.en: Grandpa likes to catch fish.
The cat catches mice in the basement.
The old buildings will be torn down next year.
The wind knocked down the tree.

forms: свађам се, свађају се; pf. посвађати се

examples.en: They're always arguing about money.
Kids, don't quarrel!
Birds fly south in the fall.
He was born in the south of Serbia.
All the passengers got out safely.

examples.sr: [Пу̑тнӣци] за Ниш, молимо вас на перон три.
examples.en: Passengers for Niš, please proceed to platform three.
Can we talk in private?
Leave us alone, please.
Put on a jacket, it's cold outside.
Where did you buy that jacket?
We had to cancel the trip.
His brakes failed on the downhill.

tips: «Отказати термин, преглед» - to cancel an appointment, a checkup.

examples.sr: Мој деда је [сле̑п] на једно око.
examples.en: My grandfather is blind in one eye.
They say love is blind.
Mom kisses the child on the cheek.
Love you, see you tomorrow!

note: usually «to kiss»; «to love» is «волети»
tips: Besides «to kiss», it is an affectionate sign-off or plea among close people: «љубим те, ћао».
«Љубити се» - to kiss each other; «пољубац» - a kiss. «Љуби ме!» - Kiss me!

examples.en: Shortly after that he left.
Soon you'll understand everything.
What's on TV tonight?
He works as a journalist in television.

tips: To watch TV is «гледам телевизију»; the set itself is «телевизор»: «купили смо нови телевизор».

examples.en: I made a cheese sandwich.
Take sandwiches for the trip.
Every year we visit Grandpa's grave.
I'll take that secret to my grave.

tips: A coffin is «ковчег» or «мртвачки сандук». «Гроб незнаног јунака» - the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

examples.en: Learning a language is a long process.
The trial against him begins in May.
Don't you recognize me?
I no longer recognize my city.
Tie your shoelaces so you don't fall.
They tied him to a chair.
I don't have the dough for that.
How much money is he asking for the car?

note: colloquial
tips: Slang for money: «кинта» (from Albanian «kindarka»), «лова» (Romani), «сом» - a thousand, «динђа» - a dinar. All colloquial.
«Ух, која лова!» - wow, what a pile of cash!

examples.en: Wait a moment.
He vanished in an instant.

note: «у трену ока» - in the blink of an eye

examples.en: I live on the fourth floor.

examples.sr: Ово ти је већ [чѐтврта] кафа данас.
examples.en: This is already your fourth coffee today.
This is plain deception!
He was arrested for fraud.
The doctor forbade me to smoke.
Smoking is prohibited here.
We're sitting in the shade of a tree.
He's afraid of his own shadow.

tips: Also figurative: «остати у нечијој сенци» - to remain in someone's shadow. Cool shade can also be «хлад» or «хладовина».
«Сенка за очи» is eyeshadow: «купила сам нову сенку».

examples.en: Is it worth the effort?
She worked hard all day.
The dog was tied up on a chain.
This store belongs to a big chain.

tips: Combinations: трговински ланац - retail chain, ланчана реакција - chain reaction, ланчани судар - pileup, планински ланац - mountain range, ланчић - small chain.

examples.en: He owns three apartments downtown.
Do you hold a driver's license?
You drive like a maniac!
He's not crazy, he's just different.
On Saturdays there's a huge crowd downtown.
I'm late, I'm stuck in traffic on the bridge.

note: «гужва» - both a crowd and a traffic jam
tips: Not only a crush: a packed schedule («у гужви сам»), a crowd at the market, lots of people in town («гужва је у граду»), traffic jams («гужва је на путу», «каснимо»).

examples.en: The hotel staff is very friendly.
The hospital lacks medical staff.
You owe me an explanation.
There must be a logical explanation.
He goes to therapy twice a week.
The doctor prescribed him a new treatment.
The enemy captured ten soldiers.

examples.sr: Два сата смо били [заро̀бљени] у лифту.
examples.en: We were trapped in the elevator for two hours.
Something here smells terrible.
Your socks stink!
Did I fill out the form correctly?
The device is working properly now.
After work go straight home.
Ask him directly, no beating around the bush.
What kind of mess is this?!

examples.sr: После утакмице је било [нѐреда] у граду.
examples.en: After the match there were riots in the city.
This week I have a lot of things to do.
You're not obliged to come.
Catch the ball!
I'm starting to get sleepy.
I'm very disappointed in you.
She was disappointed with the result.

note: разочаран + instr.: разочаран тобом - disappointed in you

examples.en: Scientists have discovered a new species of frog.
When I grow up, I'll be a scientist.
They got lost in the desert.

examples.sr: У [пу̀стињи] скоро никад не пада киша.
examples.en: It almost never rains in the desert.
We climbed up a tall rock.
He's solid as a rock.
It's a sin to throw away food.
He confessed his sins.

tips: Plural: «греси» (the older, native form) or «грехови» (later); both are correct. The adjective is «грешан».

examples.en: The child has too many toys.
Pick the toys up off the floor.
Don't eat so many sweets.
Children adore sweets.
I speak Russian and a little Serbian.
I like Russian literature.

note: говорим руски - I speak Russian

examples.en: I'm starving!

examples.sr: Многи у свету још пате од [гла̀ди].
examples.en: Many people in the world still suffer from hunger.

note: feminine: велика глад

examples.en: I've been to Paris twice.

examples.sr: Размисли [два́пут] пре него што нешто кажеш.
examples.en: Think twice before you say anything.
The guests are sitting in the living room.
What is the daily dose of this medicine?

note: дневна соба - living room

examples.en: What are you doing, for God's sake?
For God's sake, leave me alone!
He lit a cigarette on the terrace.
Someone set a car on fire last night.

note: colloquial «запалити» - to take off, to leave
tips: Slang: «запалити» - to bail, to run away («он ће да запали», «палимо кући»); also «палити» - to deceive, to string along. The basic meaning is to set on fire.

examples.en: Son, come over here for a moment!
Listen, son, life isn't easy.

note: an older person addressing a boy or young man

examples.sr: Под овим [о̀колностима] не могу да помогнем.
examples.en: Under these circumstances I can't help.
It was an unfortunate set of circumstances.
I want to express my gratitude.
We gratefully accept your help.
The car is in the garage.
Park in the underground garage.
What's your schedule for tomorrow?
They changed the class schedule.

tips: A general schedule of tasks and classes («школски распоред» - school timetable). For transport it is «ред вожње», for flights «ред летова»; a schedule with exact times is «сатница».

examples.en: The jury found him guilty.

examples.sr: Чланови [по̀роте] су се повукли на већање.
examples.en: The jury members retired to deliberate.

tips: «Порота» - the jury, «поротни суд» - a jury trial. Also: «судница» - courtroom, «оптужница» - indictment.

examples.en: A guard stands in front of the palace.
Who's on guard duty tonight?
What material is this dress made of?
I'm collecting material for a new book.
This juice tastes disgusting.
He was vile to her.
The police took away his driver's license.

examples.sr: Ако од десет [оду̀змеш] три, остаје седам.
examples.en: If you subtract three from ten, seven remains.
He traveled all over the world.
The door was wide open.
They took him in for questioning.
The opinion poll shows something different.

examples.sr: Било ми је веома [при̏ја̄тно] код вас.
examples.en: I felt very comfortable at your place.
Lunch is on the table, bon appétit!

note: «Пријатно!» - enjoy your meal; also «all the best» when parting
tips: «Пријатно!» is not only «enjoy your meal» but also a parting «all the best», for example to a shopkeeper or waiter. Informally also «Уживај!».

examples.en: Passenger safety comes first.
Fasten your seat belts for your safety.
What you're doing is sheer madness.
The concert was insane!

examples.sr: На Земљи живи више од осам [милѝја̄рдӣ] људи.
examples.en: More than eight billion people live on Earth.
The new bridge cost a billion dinars.

note: feminine: једна милијарда

examples.en: We opened the champagne at midnight.
Would you like a glass of champagne?

note: masculine: хладан шампањац

examples.en: We were all at the funeral.
The funeral will be on Friday.

note: singular: «сахрана» - a funeral

examples.en: Health is the greatest wealth.
He inherited an enormous fortune.
Let's suppose he's right.
I assumed you weren't at home.

note: «претпостављам» - I suppose, probably
tips: Spelled with т: претпоставити, претпостављам (not «предпоставити»); the prefix пред- becomes прет- before п.

examples.en: Look at yourself in the mirror.
The cat broke the mirror.
You look beautiful in that dress.
It was beautiful at the wedding.
All sorts of things happen in life.
Unbelievable! Who would have thought?

note: exclamation «Свашта!» - unbelievable!, what nonsense!
tips: As a reply, «Свашта!» can also mean "nonsense, what rubbish", showing contempt for what was said. Similar words: «глупости», «бесмислица».

examples.en: This summer we're going to Greece.
Summer is my favorite season.

note: «лети» means in summer; years of age are «година», not «лета».

examples.en: Grandpa still listens to old records.

examples.sr: На зиду је [пло̏ча] са именима палих војника.
